career_ladder.note: Gujarat Civil Services officers recruited through GPSC Class 1-2 enter either in Junior Scale Class-1 (Gujarat Administrative Service / GAS, Deputy Collector / SDM, DySP, Assistant Commissioner of State Tax) at Gujarat Pay Matrix Level 10 or Class-2 (Mamlatdar, Taluka Development Officer / TDO, Section Officer) at Level 8. Administrative officers progress through state executive postings before being inducted into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) under the promotion quota (IAS Appointment by Promotion Regulations).

exam_scheme.note: The Combined Competitive Examination (CCE) for Gujarat Administrative Service Class-1 and Gujarat Civil Services Class-1 & Class-2 consists of three stages: (1) Preliminary Examination (Objective type screening test, 2 papers of 200 marks each, 400 marks total; both papers count for merit to shortlist for Mains); (2) Main Examination (Written examination consisting of 2 qualifying language papers of 300 marks each with min 25% qualifying threshold, and 5 merit-based descriptive papers of 250 marks each, 1,250 marks total); (3) Personality Test / Interview (150 marks). Final selection merit is prepared out of 1,400 marks (1,250 written + 150 interview).

financial_package.note: Gujarat Civil Services Class 1-2 officers are compensated under the Gujarat Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 2016. Class-1 entry posts (Deputy Collector, DySP, Assistant Commissioner of State Tax) start at Gujarat Pay Matrix Level 10 (PB-3 ₹15,600–₹39,100 + GP ₹5,400) with entry basic pay of ₹56,100 (scale ₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500). Class-2 posts (Mamlatdar, Section Officer, TDO) start at Level 8 (PB-2 ₹9,300–₹34,800 + GP ₹4,400) with entry basic pay of ₹44,900 (scale ₹44,900 - ₹1,42,400).
financial_package.pay_source_label: Government of Gujarat, Finance Department — Gujarat Civil Services (Revision of Pay) Rules, 2016, Level 10 (GAS Class-1 Entry Scale)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated based on Gujarat Pay Matrix Level 10 entry basic pay of ₹56,100 at 58% DA (effective 1 Jul 2025); HRA across Gujarat municipal classifications (Class X e.g. Ahmedabad 27% / 30%, Class Y e.g. Surat/Vadodara/Rajkot 18% / 20%, Class Z other district towns 9% / 10%); net in-hand reflects statutory deductions for National Pension System (NPS 10% on Basic+DA), Gujarat State Professional Tax (₹200/mo), and Gujarat State Group Insurance Scheme (GIS).
